title: Composition reaches everywhere at odd index except at digons and the honeycomb's pinned ring
subject: Networks of rings joined by shared contacts, read with the canonical knot test on their space-time law
conclusion: On tori of every shape of the three regular lattices, a digon face kills a factor of the walk polynomial so composition cannot reach everywhere (proved), and at odd index that and the honeycomb's turn-pinned ring are the only obstructions apart from one torus of index 63 (computed to index 151). At even index no rule by the lattice mod 16, the torus group's 2-part or its mirrors decides it.
